title: Missing moeb tool: Read (absolute-path tool result file access)
description: The start_spec output exceeded the MCP result size limit and was auto-saved to an absolute system path outside the working directory. The external Read tool was required to access it because moeb's read_file only resolves relative paths from the working directory. This forces moeb-tool-origin to fail on every run where a tool result is persisted to a temp file.
proposed_resolution: Extend read_file to accept absolute paths, or add a dedicated read_tool_result tool that resolves persisted-output paths from oversized tool results. Signal a1000056-0606-4000-8000-000000000056 tracks the underlying read_file absolute-path gap.
